findings.title: StatefulSet's governing Service is missing or not headless
findings.cause: StatefulSet db's governing Service db is headless, but it selects pods with app=database and the StatefulSet's pods carry app=db; a headless Service's DNS records come from the pods it selects, so the StatefulSet's pods have no DNS names (db-0.db.kd-statefulset-service-selects-others.svc does not resolve)

evidence.what: StatefulSet db names Service db as its governing Service
evidence.command: kubectl get statefulset db -n kd-statefulset-service-selects-others -o jsonpath='{.spec.serviceName}'

evidence.what: Service db is headless and selects pods with app=database
evidence.command: kubectl get service db -n kd-statefulset-service-selects-others -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}{" "}{.spec.selector}'

findings.fix: Change Service db's selector to the StatefulSet's pod labels (app=db), or give it its own headless Service.
